item.title: Virgin Media O2 owners strike £2bn deal for Netomnia in fibre consolidation push
item.description: Liberty Global and Telefónica have agreed a £2bn deal to acquire Netomnia, expanding Virgin Media O2’s fibre reach to 20m UK premises and intensifying competition with Openreach. Read more: Virgin Media O2 owners strike £2bn deal for Netomnia in fibre consolidation push

item.title: Small businesses warn of April ‘perfect storm’ as costs surge
item.description: The Federation of Small Businesses warns 35% of small firms may close or cut output as higher wages, energy bills and tax changes hit in April. Read more: Small businesses warn of April ‘perfect storm’ as costs surge

item.title: Getting To Know You: James Doyle, Managing Director of Endeavour Group
item.description: We sit down with James Doyle, Managing Director of Endeavour Group, a building safety consultancy and training provider supporting duty holders responsible for some of the UK’s most complex and high-risk buildings. Read more: Getting To Know You: James Doyle, Managing Director of Endeavour Group

item.title: Nine in 10 high-risk pension funds fail to beat FTSE 100 over five years
item.description: Analysis shows 89% of medium-high and high-risk pension funds underperformed the FTSE 100 over five years, with some losing more than 90% of investor capital. Read more: Nine in 10 high-risk pension funds fail to beat FTSE 100 over five years

item.title: Youth unemployment hits 11-year high as rate cut expectations build
item.description: Youth unemployment has risen to 16.1%, its highest level in over a decade, adding pressure on the Bank of England to cut interest rates next month. Read more: Youth unemployment hits 11-year high as rate cut expectations build

item.title: Asos co-founder Quentin Griffiths dies after fall in Thailand
item.description: Quentin Griffiths, co-founder of Asos, has died after falling from a high-rise apartment in Pattaya, Thailand. Police say investigations are ongoing. Read more: Asos co-founder Quentin Griffiths dies after fall in Thailand

item.title: £42,000 roaming bill nearly bankrupts family firm after TikTok use abroad
item.description: A Manchester business owner was hit with a £42,000 O2 roaming bill after his daughter used TikTok in Morocco, highlighting risks of uncapped data outside Europe. Read more: £42,000 roaming bill nearly bankrupts family firm after TikTok use abroad

item.title: Record January surplus boosts public finances as tax receipts surge
item.description: The UK posted a record £30.4bn January budget surplus as tax receipts rose sharply and debt interest costs fell, strengthening the fiscal outlook. Read more: Record January surplus boosts public finances as tax receipts surge

item.title: Depop sold to eBay at 25% discount to 2021 valuation
item.description: Etsy has agreed to sell Depop to eBay for $1.2bn, a 25% discount to its 2021 purchase price, as eBay targets Gen Z resale shoppers. Read more: Depop sold to eBay at 25% discount to 2021 valuation

item.title: Aston Martin issues fresh profit warning and sells F1 naming rights for £50m
item.description: Aston Martin has issued its fifth profit warning since 2024 and sold permanent F1 naming rights for £50m as US tariffs and falling deliveries hit earnings. Read more: Aston Martin issues fresh profit warning and sells F1 naming rights for £50m
